name: sidenote
description: Live meeting assistant: reads your meeting captions and lets you ask Claude about the meeting while it happens.
long_description: Sidenote opens a small window next to your meeting. It reads the captions from Google Meet (with speaker names) or from your computer's Live Captions, keeps a transcript, an agenda, action items and questions to ask, and lets you ask Claude about the meeting at any moment. Meeting files are saved on your computer in Documents/Sidenote. Type 'open Sidenote' in a Claude chat to start.

tools.name: open_sidenote
tools.description: Show the Sidenote window and start reading meeting captions.

tools.name: close_sidenote
tools.description: Close the Sidenote window and stop reading captions.

tools.name: wait_for_question
tools.description: Live mode: wait for a question typed in the Sidenote window.

tools.name: update_meeting_info
tools.description: Save or change the meeting title, agenda, role, goals and participants.

tools.name: add_agenda_items
tools.description: Add agenda items without removing existing ones.

tools.name: add_participants
tools.description: Add participant names.

tools.name: add_action_item
tools.description: Save an action item from the meeting.

tools.name: add_questions_to_ask
tools.description: Save questions to ask later in the meeting.

tools.name: mark_done
tools.description: Mark an agenda item, action item or question as done.

tools.name: set_context_sources

tools.name: add_context_item

tools.name: save_recap

tools.name: debug_meet_tree

tools.name: debug_live_captions_tree

tools.name: get_meeting_context
tools.description: Return the meeting title, agenda, participants, role and goals.

tools.name: get_recent_transcript
tools.description: Return the transcript from the last few minutes.

tools.name: get_full_transcript

tools.name: show_suggestion
tools.description: Show a short answer in the Sidenote window.

tools.name: start_new_meeting

tools.name: get_status
